LESSON: READING 5.2.2 PHONIC AWARENESS (K-R)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.2 Phonic awareness (k-r)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.2 Phonic awareness (k-r), part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Which things in the class have sound ‘k’ in their name? 2. Which things in the classroom are also found at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.2 Phonic awareness (k-r) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: Inclusion as learners work together in chanting letter sounds while competing on the signing speed and the reading

speed.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Citizenship as learner appreciates things found in their neighbourhood.

• Effective communication: life skill as learners learn about sounds, chant rhymes on sounds and relate the sounds to

corresponding signs and objects.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learner relates matching in mathematical activities

Suggested Learning Resources:

assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, signed audio visual recordings, relevant

digital devices, online resources, storybooks, flashcards
